title: Exclude one-chart BIT retag donors (0% κ change)
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

All 22,190 chart and delivery pairs over 35 deliveries were checked, including nonnested and oblique charts. Zero remain unresolved in this scope.

The directed whole-word price at κ = 0.0040075385047236 requires more than 88.3884026799643 raw units of further compatible savings after charging 18 retagged calls and crediting 111 formal rank-one savings. The replay saves that price before checking support. The optimistic compatible stock saving is exactly zero, with free formation, routing, ownership and restoration, and independent donor choices.

~~~sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/bit-one-chart-donor-envelope
python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/bit-one-chart-donor-envelope --check-modes --check-source-history
~~~

The primary binary-span replay and a separate dual-equation replay cover all pairs with the same source-pinned trace and geometry. The package checks 973 strict-prefix predecessor cases and reconstructs the complete 36-copy paid and productive invoice. The official Git-free export matched registered replay. Six navigation tests passed. A corrupted invoice was rejected. The exact directed price and per-delivery receipts are included.
